Standardized category code of maintenance task
Corridor track section identifier between bounding stations
Directional railway line (UP or DN)
Start kilometer post of the maintenance section

Alpha code of the governing railway station (foreign key to stations_clean)

Safety criticality score on 0 to 10 scale (higher indicates greater safety risk if deferred)
Asset physical degradation score on 0 to 10 scale
Number of days elapsed past maintenance inspection/servicing due date
Gross Million Tonnes of rail traffic carried by asset section

Planning scheduling horizon (DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY)
Operational lifecycle status of maintenance task

Full formal name of railway station
Railway operational administrative division
Zonal railway headquarters abbreviation (e.g. NR, NCR, ECR)
State or Union Territory location of station

description: Geographic longitude of station in decimal degrees
transformation: Converted to float, validated within bounds

Total number of passenger platforms available at station
